# ParticleSway

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct ParticleSway(FloatRange Amplitude, FloatRange Frequency)
```

Types: [`FloatRange`](FloatRange.md)
